description: A FastAPI application that defines an Item model using Pydantic, with an endpoint to update items via PUT request.

classes.name: Item
classes.description: A Pydantic model representing an item with optional description and tax fields.

methods.name: update_item(item_id: int, item: Item, q: str | None = None)
methods.description: Asynchronous function handling PUT requests to update an item by ID, returning item data and optional query parameter.

ctags.name: update_item
ctags.pattern: /^async def update_item(item_id: int, item: Item, q: str | None = None):$/
ctags.signature: (item_id: int, item: Item, q: str | None = None)
